description: HTML file for TinyMCE plugin 'advlink' containing UI for inserting and configuring links, including tabs for general, popup, event, and advanced properties.

methods.name: executeOnLoad
methods.description: Initializes the plugin when the popup loads.

methods.name: displayTab
methods.description: Switches between different property tabs in the UI.

methods.name: selectByValue
methods.description: Selects options in dropdowns based on value.

methods.name: setPopupControlsDisabled
methods.description: Enables or disables popup configuration controls.

methods.name: buildOnClick
methods.description: Builds the link or popup action based on current form inputs.

methods.name: insertAction
methods.description: Inserts the configured link into the editor.
